posts.post: calling an outfit ‘basic’ is just the easy way to admit you don’t know how to style a silhouette without loud prints.
are you a person who keeps the tags on until you leave the house, or do you commit the second the box is open?
if you’ve never had an emotional breakdown in a dressing room, have you ever actually shopped?
the real ones know the true test of a pair of trousers is how they handle a full meal and a long sit.
